AGENDA
  SENIOR SERVICES COMMITTEE SPECIAL MEETING
  ADULT RECREATION CENTER
  201 E. Colorado St.
  Glendale, CA 91205
Welcome to the meeting of the Senior Services Committee. Meetings are open to the public and
held at the Adult Recreation Center at 201 E. Colorado Street, Glendale, CA 91205. Meeting
minutes  will  be  available  for  viewing  on  the  City  Website  at
https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/public-meeting-portal. If you have any questions about
matters on the agenda or requests for assistance, please contact (818) 548-3715 during regular
business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES DURING THE MEETING.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Community Services & Parks Administration Office, 613 E. Broadway, RM 120, Glendale, CA
91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.
  AUGUST 20, 2025 AT 2:30 PM
A SPECIAL MEETING of the Senior Services Committee is hereby called to meet at 2:30 PM on
August 20, 2025, in the Adult Recreation Center to consider the following items of business, to wit:

  1.  ROLL CALL
  a.  Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the August
  20, 2025, special meeting of the Senior Services Committee Special Meeting was
  posted on or before August 19, 2025, on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

  2.  INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a.  Introduction of 2025-2026 Senior Services Committee members

  3.  CONSENT ITEMS
   a.  Approval of the Minutes of the March 27, 2025 Senior Services Committee
  Special Meeting

4.  COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS

5.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed five (5)
  minutes. The Committee may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.
  The Director or designee may refer the matter to the proper section for investigation and
  report.

6.  ACTION ITEMS
  a.  Selection of Senior Services Committee Officers
  1. Selection of Chair for the term August 2025-August 2026
  2. Selection of Vice-Chair for the term August 2025-August 2026
  b.  FY 2025-2026 Senior Services Committee Meeting Schedule
  1. Motion to approve the proposed FY 2025-2026 Senior Services Committee Meeting
  Schedule
  c.  Direction on Implementation of Senior Needs Assessment Recommendations
  1. Motion to provide direction on the prioritization and implementation of next steps for
  policy and programming based on the recommendations outlined in the Senior Needs
  Assessment (SNA).

7.  REPORTS - INFORMATION ONLY
  a.  Senior Programs and Events Update (May 2025- July 2025)

8.  ADJOURNMENT
